Best memories

The little details that made the trip yours.

🐒 Monkey Hill

A monkey stole a monk's bunch of grapes - followed by a slingshot chase.

🌧️ Krabi storm

Lia, Talya and Mark arrived at the Ao Nang Landmark Night Market to pitch darkness during a full power outage and a crazy rainstorm. 7-Eleven was closed with people locked inside, there was nowhere to eat and huge puddles everywhere. After an hour, the lights came back on and we were saved.

🚙 Pai jeep adventure

Three days with Jean: ziplining, Sticky Waterfall, the Chinese tea village, the Long Neck tribe, Big Buddha, mountain roads, rafting and elephants.

🎂 Mark's birthday

Cake and candles at midnight, amazingly touching cards from the kids (and TicTacs from Talya), a hot stone massage in the morning and Chatuchak Weekend Market during the day.

🛺 Tuk-tuk soundtrack

A music-filled tuk-tuk ride home after Railay and the Ao Nang night market.

✈️ Business class

Received 2 upgrades to business class on the flight home - which started with Mark and Limor sitting there and ended with Lia and MATAN!!!

Funny quotes from the trip

The lines that still make us laugh.

“Raining on your side?”

As we're landing in Bangkok, Talya looks out the window from the right side of the plane, sees it's raining, and calls over to Matan on the left: “Matan, is it also raining on your side?”

- Talya 21:7 - The Landing
“As little as possible”

At a market, Talya wanted a hat and Mark told her what price to aim for. She went off with Lia (with Limor's social worker stance) to negotiate. On the way back, Lia told her that if Dad asked what she paid, to say as little as possible (“תגידי כמה שפחות”) meaning, don't elaborate. When Mark asked the price. Talya proudly replied: “As little as possible.”

- Talya 8:3 - Lost in translation, perfectly

Trip Itinerary - Day by Day

Jul 21Travel → Chiang Mai

Arrival in Thailand

  • Landed in Bangkok at 2:00pm
  • Starbucks, food and foreign exchange
  • 7:35pm flight to Chiang Mai - upgraded to business class
  • Checked in to Shangri-La Chiang Mai
Jul 22Chiang Mai

Pool + night market

  • Pool day
  • Night market
Jul 23Chiang Mai

Cooking class + late-night surprise

  • Central Festival Mall
  • Thai cooking class with market tour
  • Surprised Efrat and Shmoulic at Dusit Princess just before midnight
  • Celebrated Doron's 14th birthday with balloons and cake
Cooking class: THB 1,000 per person including pickup and drop-off · THB 5,000 total · paid by credit card.
Jul 24Chiang Mai

ATV day with Efrat and Shmoulic

  • Extreme sports center together with Efrat and Shmoulic
  • Matan drove a big ATV, Talya a small one
  • Lia and Limor rode together
Single rider ATV: THB 1,600 × 3 · Double ATV: THB 2,200 · THB 7,000 total · cash.
🚙 July 25-27 - Jeep trip to Pai · with our driver Jean
Jul 25Jeep tour → Pai

Zipline, Karen village + Sticky Waterfall

  • 9:30am pickup; Red Brick briefing and luggage storage
  • Jeep with our driver Jean
  • Ziplining through the trees
  • Long-neck Karen village
  • Bua Tong “Sticky Waterfall”
  • Coffee stop, then the famously curvy drive to Pai
  • Checked in to Pai Cherkaew Boutique House
Pai jeep trip: THB 5,900 per person after the THB 1,000-per-person own-hotel discount · THB 29,500 total · cash.
Jul 26Pai · Jeep trip

Big Buddha, Yunnan village + Pai Canyon

  • 9:15am pickup with Jean
  • Wat Phra That Mae Yen - 293 steps to the Big White Buddha
  • Scenic lookout over the Chinese village
  • Yunnan village, market, archery and shooting range
  • Rice fields and bamboo bridge
  • Pai Canyon lookout
  • Dinner with Efrat & Shmoulic at Limoncello, then night market
Jul 27Pai → Chiang Mai · Jeep trip

Elephants + “brown water rafting”

  • Fed elephants and bathed them in the river
  • “Brown water rafting”
  • Lunch at the rafting trail end
  • Drove back to Chiang Mai and said goodbye to Jean
  • Chiang Mai night market
Jul 28Chiang Mai → Phuket

South to Phuket

  • Picked up laundry and stopped at Lion Café
  • Bangkok Airways PG248 · 2:35pm Chiang Mai → 4:40pm Phuket
  • About 1.5 hours to Phuket Emerald Beach Resort
  • Dinner at Turkish restaurant Pasha in the rain
Jul 29Phuket

Resort day + OTOP night market

  • Pool day at the Emerald Resort
  • OTOP night market in Phuket
Jul 30Phuket

Cats, monkeys + shopping

  • Top Cat café
  • Monkey Hill - including the memorable grape-stealing monkey episode
  • Central Festival Mall
Top Cat: THB 350 per person · THB 1,750 total · cash.
Jul 31Phuket

Andamanda Water Park

  • Full day at Andamanda
  • Karon night market
THB 6,699 for 4 tickets + 2 lockers + meal package, plus THB 1,600 for one additional ticket · THB 8,299 total · credit card.
Aug 1Phuket → Krabi

Road trip to Krabi

  • Checked out of Phuket Emerald Resort
  • Private van to Krabi - about 3.5 hours
  • Checked in to Sofitel Phokeethra
  • Italian dinner via Grab at the hotel
Private van: THB 3,000 with 5 suitcases and 5 trolleys.
Aug 2Krabi

Pool + Ao Nang night market

  • Pool day at Sofitel
  • Met Chen and Ido Mittelman and family
  • Dinner at Ao Nang Landmark Night Market

Railay Beach

  • Longtail boat to Railay Beach

Aug 4Krabi

Yoga, pool + storm

Bangkok begins

  • Sushiro at CentralWorld

Aug 6Bangkok

Easy hotel day

  • Limor and Lia got their nails done
  • Mark and the twins worked out

  • Games room
Aug 7Bangkok

Massage + canal tour

  • Massage at Serene Spa across from the hotel

  • One-hour Bangkok canal tour
  • Shabbat dinner at Azzura in MBK Center
Bangkok canal tour: THB 2,000 total · cash.
Aug 8Bangkok · Mark's birthday

Mark's birthday + Chatuchak

  • Birthday cake and candles at midnight
  • Amazingly touching birthday cards from the kids - plus TicTacs from Talya
  • Hot stone massage in the morning at the hotel spa
  • Chatuchak Weekend Market during the day
  • Lunch at Cheap Shots - fish and chips
  • Back to MBK with Efrat and Shmoulic
  • Ordered Sushilover via Grab when Sushiro had closed

Last day

  • Checked out of the hotel… somehow
  • Games room
  • Limor and Lia massage using hotel-spa tokens
  • Ride to the airport
